name: What design considerations are important for multi-height countertops?

mainEntity.name: What design considerations are important for multi-height countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key design considerations include the intended function of each height level, clearance for seating, accessibility for users of varying heights, and how the different levels integrate aesthetically with the overall kitchen design. Ensuring smooth transitions between heights, selecting appropriate edge profiles for safety and style, and coordinating material choices are also crucial. Proper planning ensures the multi-height design enhances both the functionality and visual appeal of your kitchen space.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider function, seating clearance, accessibility, aesthetic integration, and safe transitions between different heights.
